utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning to all. Could the registrar call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. This is case number IT-02-60/1-A, Momir Nikolic versus The Prosecutor.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Mr. Nikolic, can you follow the proceedings in a language that you understand?

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I'm not receiving interpretation.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Obviously there's a technical problem. Can you now hear me? Mr. Nikolic, can you now -- can you hear me, Mr. Nikolic?

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I can hear only French. No, I'm not receiving interpretation.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Nikolic, can you follow the proceedings in a language that you understand? I have just been told that the technicians will try to solve the problem.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: It seems to be working now. It should be channel 6. B/C/S should be channel 6.

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, I can hear it now.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Nikolic, are you able to confirm that you can follow the proceedings in a language that you understand?

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, Your Honour. I confirm that I can follow the proceedings in a language I understand.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Mr. Nikolic. You may sit down.

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can the parties introduce themselves. And I will start with the members of the Office of the Prosecutor, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. KREMER
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. Peter Kremer, representing the Prosecution. Marie-Ursula Kind is with me.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Microphone, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. KREMER
utterances.text: I'm sorry. Lourdes Galicia is also here.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Mr. Kremer. Thank you very much, Mr. Kremer. And I would like the Defence counsel to introduce themselves.

utterances.speaker: MR. TANSEY
utterances.text: Rock Tansey and John Livingston for Mr. Nikolic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: Thank you. [Interpretation] Thank you. In this case, Mr. Nikolic has filed a notice of appeal against a judgement pronounced on December 2nd, 2003. Whilst awaiting the hearing on appeal, Mr. Nikolic is detained in the Detention Unit of the United Nations in The Hague, in the Netherlands. In accordance with the provisions of Rule 65 bis (B) of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence of the Tribunal, a Status Conference is convened within 120 days after the last Status Conference, to allow the person in custody, pending appeal, the opportunity to raise issues in relation thereto, including the mental and physical condition of the person. Mr. Nikolic, or I'm turning to your counsel, would you like to inform me of any concern related to the condition of your detention or to your state of health? Mr. Nikolic, you have the floor.

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Your Honour. I have no complaints concerning the Detention Unit or my detention, but I said even the last time that I do have certain health problems, and I'm undergoing intensive treatment at the Detention Unit in keeping with their abilities.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. I take note of what you have just told us, and you may sit down, please.

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] As far as the appeal status is concerned, I note that there is no pending application before the Trial Chamber. The Scheduling Order of the 19th October 2005 has informed the parties that the appeal hearing will take place on the 5th of December, 2005, between 9.00 and 10.30. I have nothing further to add, and I would like to know whether the parties would like to raise any question or any issue. Mr. Kremer?

utterances.speaker: MR. KREMER
utterances.text: We have nothing to raise or to add at this time.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Microphone, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Mr. Kremer. And I would like to turn towards the Defence. Mr. Tansey.

utterances.speaker: MR. TANSEY
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues]... thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. If there is no further question, this Status Conference can now be adjourned. It is so decided.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: at 9.12 a.m.
